Reachable keeps an element that an inline style hides, and never a script

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ConversionOptions, HiddenContent, convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const options: ConversionOptions = { hiddenContent: HiddenContent.Reachable };
  const result = convert("<p>visible</p><div style=\"display:none\">collapsed body<script>var code = 1;</script></div>", options);
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
